source_analysis.source_rhetorical_arc: A skeptical narrator enters an unfamiliar public activity, observes increasingly revealing details, revises an initial judgment, and ends by participating more fully.
source_analysis.reusable_architecture: First-person expectation-to-participation narrative with observation, contrast, and a closing behavioral change.
copyright_risk_notes: Do not reuse Finland, phones, throwing, competitive events, costumes, recycling, or any source action sequence.

blueprints.new_topic_domain: A teenager reluctantly attending a neighborhood repair cafe and helping restore a desk fan
blueprints.rhetorical_arc: Dismiss the event as a room of broken objects; observe patient collaborative repairs; assist with one repair; reconsider the value of maintenance and shared skill.
blueprints.originality_strategy: Replace competition and spectacle with quiet cooperative problem solving, different setting, different stakes, and an object-centered participation arc.

blueprints.new_topic_domain: A student joining a predawn community mural installation and learning to place mirrored tiles
blueprints.rhetorical_arc: Arrive doubtful that small pieces matter; watch the wall change with the light; accept a precise task; recognize how individual contributions form a shared image.
blueprints.originality_strategy: Use visual craft, predawn work, and cumulative design rather than sport, recycling, travel, or comic performance.
